answer.answer: Neither. ST-EVA holds no current P/S (price-to-sales) figure for AAPL, and it did not calculate one. A query for a 'current_ps' metric was refused as an unknown metric name; the registry's known metrics contain no valuation multiple of any kind — no P/S, no market capitalisation, no share price. The coverage report for AAPL lists 12 metrics held (assets, capex, cash, debt, dividend_per_share, eps_diluted, guidance, net_income, operating_margin_bank, revenue, segment_revenue, shares_outstanding), none of which is a valuation ratio. The two operands a P/S would need are also not both present: revenue is held as SOURCE_REPORTED from SEC filings (most recent nine-month figure 364,357,000,000 USD for 2025-09-28 to 2026-06-27, and 109,417,000,000 USD for the quarter ended 2026-06-27), and shares outstanding is held as SOURCE_REPORTED (14,594,180,000 as of 2026-07-17), but no share price or market capitalisation is held, so even a derived ratio has no numerator available. So the question of reported-versus-calculated does not arise: there is nothing to report and nothing that was computed.
uncertainties: No observation exists to cite for the P/S itself, because no such metric is known to ST-EVA at all; the finding rests on the metric-name refusal and on the AAPL coverage report, not on an observation row.
Whether a current P/S was computed outside this database cannot be determined from the evidence held here.

The revenue figure cited is the nine-month cumulative period, not a trailing-twelve-month figure; no TTM revenue series is held, and revenue's series carries two earlier PARTIAL concept-mapping breaks (SalesRevenueNet to 2018-06-30, Revenues to 2018-09-29) that pre-date the current EXACT concept.
